plugin.name: QWeather
plugin.description: QWeather (和风天气): current conditions, hourly and 7-day forecasts, weather warnings, air quality and life indices — a drop-in replacement for the built-in weather widget.
settings.api_host.label: API Host
settings.api_host.description: Your dedicated API host from the QWeather console (Settings → API Host), for example abcdefg.re.qweatherapi.com — without https://. Public hosts such as api.qweather.com or devapi.qweather.com are no longer issued to new accounts.
settings.auth_mode.label: Authentication
settings.auth_mode.description: API Key is what the console shows by default; JWT (Ed25519) is the credential QWeather recommends for new projects.
settings.api_key.label: API Key
settings.api_key.description: API Key from the QWeather console (Project → Credentials), 32 hex characters. Sent as the X-QW-Api-Key header.
settings.jwt_private_key.label: JWT private key
settings.jwt_private_key.description: Path to the Ed25519 private key (PEM) you uploaded to the console as public key.
settings.jwt_kid.label: Key ID (kid)
settings.jwt_kid.description: The credential ID shown next to the public key in the console.
settings.jwt_sub.label: Project ID (sub)
settings.jwt_sub.description: The project ID the credential belongs to.
settings.location_mode.label: Location source
settings.location_mode.description: Where the coordinates come from. "Noctalia location" follows the shell's location service (city-level by IP), the other modes pin an explicit place.
settings.city_name.label: City name
settings.city_name.description: Resolved once through the QWeather GeoAPI, for example 北京, Shanghai, Tokyo.
settings.latitude.label: Latitude
settings.longitude.label: Longitude
settings.location_id.label: LocationID
settings.location_id.description: The 8-10 digit LocationID used by all QWeather endpoints, for example 101010100.
settings.lang.label: Language
settings.lang.description: Language of the returned text (weather descriptions, city names).
settings.unit.label: Units
settings.unit.description: Metric uses °C / km/h / km; imperial uses °F / mph / mi (QWeather unit=m and unit=i).
settings.refresh_minutes.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
settings.refresh_minutes.description: How often the service polls QWeather. The free plan has a daily request quota, so 15-30 minutes is a sane default.
settings.daily_days.label: Daily forecast length
settings.daily_days.description: How many days the daily forecast covers.
settings.hourly_hours.label: Hourly forecast length
settings.hourly_hours.description: How many hours the hourly forecast covers.
settings.fetch_warning.label: Weather warnings
settings.fetch_warning.description: Fetch active severe-weather warnings for the location.
settings.fetch_air.label: Air quality
settings.fetch_air.description: Fetch the current air quality index (AQI) and primary pollutant.
settings.fetch_indices.label: Life indices
settings.fetch_indices.description: Fetch the daily life indices (dressing, sport, UV, ...). Uses one extra request per cycle.
settings.show_text.label: Show temperature
settings.show_text.description: Draw the temperature next to the icon in the bar.
settings.show_location.label: Show city
settings.show_location.description: Prefix the bar text with the city name.
settings.show_feels.label: Show feels-like
settings.show_feels.description: Show the apparent temperature instead of the measured one.
settings.show_high_low.label: Show high/low
settings.show_humidity.label: Show humidity
settings.show_wind.label: Show wind
settings.fallback_glyph.label: Placeholder icon
settings.fallback_glyph.description: Icon shown while data is loading or the plugin is not configured yet.
settings.glyph_color.label: Icon colour
settings.glyph_color.description: How the weather icon is tinted in the bar.
bar.hint_body: Left click: details · Right click: refresh · Middle click: settings
bar.not_configured: Not configured yet — open the panel or the plugin settings.
panel.title: QWeather
panel.empty: No data yet. Configure the plugin, then refresh.
panel.setup_step1: 1. Create a free project at console.qweather.com and copy your API Host.
panel.setup_step2: 2. Paste the API Host and API Key into the plugin settings.
panel.setup_step3: 3. Pick where the location comes from, then press Refresh.
desktop.need_config: Set the API host and credentials first
panel.settings_body: Open Settings → Plugins → ylxc/qweather to fill it in
settings.jwt_iss.label: Developer ID (iss)
settings.jwt_iss.description: The developer ID from the QWeather console (Project management): a 10-character string starting with Q.
